Eventuality

Class

A particular entity that is a way of being or a modification of one or more other entities - qualifying them or making them be or go in a certain way - and is individuated by those entities

Note

An eventuality is not general, but is linked to its participants - that is, the entities that bear it or are involved in it; the wisdom of Socrates is numerically distinct from the wisdom of Diogenes, and they existed at different times; the redness of this apple is distinct from the redness of that other apple, and so on

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
